headline: Reflection releases Beam 1.0 as a 501B-parameter open-weight model
summary: Reflection released Beam 1.0 weights on October 16 under Apache 2.0, with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 variants. Its model card lists a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501.3B total and 23.4B active parameters and a 1M-token context window. Reflection reports strong coding, reasoning and tool-use benchmark scores, but these remain vendor-run results without an independent reproduction. A linked safety report rates the model Limited across four systemic-risk categories while disclosing narrow, mixed evaluations and important sample and task limits.
